limitations: WebKit is tested through the WebKit build pinned by Playwright. It is not Safari or iOS certification.
SKIP and UNSUPPORTED results are not passes and fail the gate.
The service worker caches only the app shell. It never caches /api/ traffic, so offline data is read from IndexedDB.
Recovery after an abrupt process kill is not covered. Only orderly page reload and browser restart are tested.
Performance is not measured here. This lane reports functional browser behavior only.

backwardCompatibility.reason: Opening 0.1.3 data with 0.1.1, 0.1.2 or RxDB 17.6.0 is a separate question. No downgrade is assumed.

limitations: This lineage runs on fake-indexeddb, so it is simulated IndexedDB. Native browser IndexedDB lineage is a separate lane and stays pending until it is actually run.
One writer at a time only. No two versions write to the same database concurrently.
The migration step is a schema version 0 to 1 open in the candidate, not a migration shipped by a published release.
Timing samples come from one host under uncontrolled background load. They are not a ranking or a gate.
